## Experience

- SDS Manager, Software Engineer (July 2025 – Present): FastAPI services for AI features, compliance tooling, hazard classification from historical data.
- Goama, Full-stack Developer (May 2022 – August 2025): Django/DRF for high-traffic apps, payments in Latin America (+20% reach), unit tests (−30% bugs), CI/CD to Kubernetes.
- Aadi BD Ltd., Software Engineer (June 2020 – April 2022): Cross-border e-commerce, a local delivery system (+40% logistics efficiency), Redx, Pathao, DHL and UPS integrations.
- Venture Solutions Ltd., Jr. Software Engineer (May 2019 – March 2020): Booking app for convention halls, internal CRM, payment gateway integration.
- Tryonyx (now The Prestige Global), Internship (Feb 2019 – May 2019): Python, Django and Flutter foundations.
